selection.rule: smallest band_mix_margin in {0.05, 0.075, 0.10, 0.125} such that, with rci_obf levels at alpha 0.05 and the pooled margin 0.05, the final-look band (n = N_max = 275, judged alone) passes a candidate with no survival change with probability >= 0.90 in EVERY independent between-checkpoint pool: FRP-v2 Phase 2, FRP-v2 Phase 1 and each of the six FRP-v2 Phase 1 recipe cells (the realistic range of between-checkpoint paired survival SDs); the 0.10 headroom over the 0.80 target absorbs SD uncertainty and the pooled component
